# markdown-it-extra-link
> A markdown-it extension for typed inline links such as {link:post:123}.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/markdown-it-extra-link/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/markdown-it-extra-link
Status: documented
Last verified: 2026-11-17
